title: The Unbearable Lightness of Agent Optimization — Alberto Romero, Jointly
talk_summary: Alberto Romero presents Meta-AC, a framework that adds a learned meta-controller on top of ACE-style context engineering to route each task to a combination of strategies (minimal context, reflection, adaptive compute, hierarchical verification, structured memory, test-time training) based on task complexity, uncertainty, verifiability, and resource budget. Results are preliminary (8-11% benchmark gains, 30-40% compute reduction) and the system is not fully implemented, so most value is in the architectural patterns rather than proven numbers.

takeaways.what_they_do: Profile each task on semantic complexity, uncertainty, verifiability, and resource availability, producing a 32-dim embedding that drives which strategy and budget to allocate.
takeaways.evidence_quote: profiles each task and allocates the right combination of strategies across context, compute, verification, memory and parameter dimensions

takeaways.what_they_do: Simple tasks get minimal processing, moderate tasks get reflection plus verification, complex tasks get heavy test-time compute and memory retrieval, instead of running the same heavy pipeline for everything.
takeaways.evidence_quote: simple tasks um require minimal processing can save n around a 90% uh compute compared to standard AC
takeaways.numbers: ~90% compute savings on simple tasks; 30-40% overall compute reduction claimed

takeaways.what_they_do: Three tiers: fast self-verification when confidence is high, then confidence-weighted multi-model consensus, then execution-based checks (sandbox, API validation, schema compliance).
takeaways.evidence_quote: hierarchical verification cascade um where we can expect a 50 to 60% reduction in errors from poor feedback

takeaways.what_they_do: A learned classifier blocks harmful context deltas when the reflector is unreliable, and the controller reroutes to verification or test-time compute instead of trusting bad reflection.
takeaways.evidence_quote: a learned classifier that blocks harmful deltas
takeaways.numbers: claims 80%+ performance maintained when reflector degrades ~30%

takeaways.what_they_do: Collect task outcomes, per-strategy contribution, efficiency metrics, and confidence calibration, then update the controller's routing policy over time.
takeaways.evidence_quote: a feedback aggregation layer that collects the outcomes and updates the meta controllers policy through metalarning

takeaways.technique: Lazy execution, batching, caching for overhead
takeaways.what_they_do: Acknowledge profiling and multi-strategy overhead and mitigate with lazy execution, batching, and caching rather than always running every strategy.
takeaways.evidence_quote: we can leverage things like lazy execution, batching and caching
